headline: International Focus on Taiwan's Energy Risks; MOEA: Diversified Procurement Ensures Stable Power Supply | Industry
summary: Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs said LNG imports last year came from 14 countries and coal sourcing spanned Asia, the Americas and Africa. It said diversified procurement and renewable expansion support stable power supply.
why: Taiwan imports nearly all of its energy, so LNG and coal supply security directly affects power costs and industrial output. Diversified sourcing reduces exposure to any single supplier.
